# Kotlin Spring Developer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > Kotlin

## Overview

Builds Spring Boot applications in Kotlin with idiomatic DSL usage, coroutine support, and Kotlin-specific Spring features

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [kotlin-spring-developer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
kotlin-spring-developer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@kotlin-spring-developer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build Spring Boot apps with Kotlin idioms
- Use Kotlin DSL for bean definition and routing
- Implement coroutine-based controllers with WebFlux
- Configure data access with Spring Data and Kotlin extensions

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Spring Kotlin**: Spring Boot Kotlin-specific features and patterns
- **WebFlux**: Reactive web endpoints with coroutine support
- **MockK**: Kotlin-first mocking library for testing
